items.stem: In the passage, it is stated that when the number of diameters increases, the number of divisions also increases. What is this relationship called?
If the number of students increases, the number of laddoos each student gets decreases. What type of proportion is this?

A farmer picked 180 bors from his trees. He gave them equally to 45 students. Each student got bors. Had there been 60 students, each would have got bors. What is the relationship between the number of students and the number of bors each gets?
The cost of 12 quintals of soyabean is 36,000 rupees. How much will 8 quintals cost?
Jaya, Seema, Nikhil and Neelesh invested 360000 rupees in the ratio 3:4:7:6. They made a profit of 12%. How much profit did Nikhil make?
Suresh and Ramesh together invested 144000 rupees in the ratio 4:5. They sold the land at a profit of 20%. What is Suresh's share of the profit?
If the number of workers increases, what happens to the time required to complete a task?
If 600 rupees buy 15 bunches of feed, how many bunches can 1280 rupees buy?
If 15 workers take 8 hours to build a wall, how many hours will 12 workers take?

In a business, if the profit is shared in the same proportion as the investment, which of the following is correct?
If 10 pens cost 60 rupees, what is the cost of 13 pens?
If 15 workers take 8 hours to build a wall, how many hours will 12 workers take?
